data.name: Three Rounds
data.description: A four person squad went to watch a bonded handover on the east road and has missed two signal windows. Four B rank shinobi have gone quiet inside our own border.
data.successDescription: He was never unbeatable. He was expensive, and he could not afford himself for longer than a minute.

objectives.description:
Pale Fang has beaten two village hunters and let both walk home.

He sent word that he will give a third the same courtesy.
He salutes before he moves. He means it, and it does not slow him down.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent

objectives.description: He let the first two go to make sure a third would come.
Contract closed.
Go again.

data.name: The Long Winter
data.description: Three people have died in nine days, in three districts, with nothing in common except that all five of them signed one authorisation during the border winter. Two names are left on that page, and one of them is yours to protect.
data.successDescription: The village bought four convoys of grain across a closed border and paid for three. Not because anyone decided to cheat him. Because the paperwork was built so that nobody would ever have to know his name.

objectives.description:
Winter Crow has not moved camp in four months.

She is not hiding. She is waiting for the village to get tired.
She stands up as you enter the clearing, unhurried, already reaching.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent

objectives.description: She outlasted three hunters before you. She did not outlast the fourth.
Contract closed.
Go again.

data.name: Old Ghost
data.description: An old Bingo Book entry, faded and worn, pinned to the mission board with a fresh brief. Old Ghost. Resurfaced after years in hiding. Once ran an ANBU cell in this village.
data.successDescription: Four squads have filed this report. The entry is still open.

objectives.description:
An old bounty contract, faded, pinned beside a fresh brief.

Old Ghost ran an ANBU cell here once. He is back.
He does not run. He waited for someone from the village to come.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent

objectives.description: He knew every name on the wall. That is why they sent him away.
Contract closed.
Go again.

data.name: The Tenth Name
data.description: A page taken off a body lists ten entries. Nine are copied out of our own Bingo Book in a hand that is not ours. The tenth has no name on it, only a service number with this village's prefix and a date eight months out. Copies are in transit.
data.successDescription: Nobody infiltrated anything. The four fields on every entry are public record, printed by this village about its own people and pinned to a wall.

objectives.description:
Nine names on the Forsworn list are crossed out.

The tenth has no crossing and no face.
The one who answers to the tenth name meets you without introducing themselves.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent

objectives.description: The list is closed. Nobody is sure the tenth name was ever a person.
Contract closed.
Go again.
